comment_regular: Verified Oblivion path: for each available endpoint cell with an owner, writes its bit-0x40 temp-public state to the unlocked argument; Lock callers pass false and Unlock callers true. Fallout homolog DoorTeleportData::SetConnectedCellsPublic likewise applies TESObjectCELL::SetTempPublic to the linked and local endpoint cells when owned. Divergence: Oblivion exposes this as a standalone linked-door lock-state helper, while Fallout places it on DoorTeleportData and names the boolean public state.
